name: DeckCraft

limitations: - OpenGL: AROS One 1.3 has only Mesa's software renderer, so AUTO uses CPU
there. GPU works with it but draws a frame in seconds; use it only to try.

aros-x86_64-abiv1-pc.system: AROS x86_64, mainline ABIv1 (nightly 2026-11-24 or later)
aros-x86_64-abiv1-pc.sdk: x86_64 mainline ABIv1 SDK of nightly 2026-11-24
limitations: - AUTO uses CPU on this system: a program that has opened OpenGL leaves its
log file in use after it ends, and the Shell it ran in stops redirecting
the output of later programs (seen on nightly 2026-11-10). GPU opens
OpenGL all the same; with VirGL in an emulator it drew correctly but took
about ten seconds a frame. Hardware OpenGL drivers have not been tested.

aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.system: AROS on Raspberry Pi, AArch64 ABIv1 (nightly 2026-11-24 or later)
aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.sdk: Raspberry Pi AArch64 ABIv1 SDK of nightly 2026-11-24
limitations: - OpenGL has not been tested on Pi hardware, so AUTO uses CPU. GPU opens
OpenGL; save your work before you try it.
- Tested in an emulator only, not on a physical Raspberry Pi.
- Media in presentations plays without sound: there is no audio output.
- No printing: export to PDF instead. Files dropped on the window are not
opened, and Presenter View needs a second display, which is not offered.
- Formatted (HTML) clipboard content is not available; copy and paste use
plain text and pictures.
- Changes of the whole window (scrolling, zooming, opening a dialog) redraw
all of it; on slow machines and in emulators these follow with a delay.
- Run one DeckCraft at a time: AutoRecover cannot tell that another
DeckCraft is running and may take over its recovery data.
- Only Latin-script fonts are built in. Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic
and emoji characters are kept in presentations but shown as boxes.
- The slide show, transitions, video, pasting a picture from the clipboard,
the file requesters and keyboard layouts other than the US one have not
been tested on AROS in this release.
- No automatic updates: install new versions with the AROS package manager
or by unpacking the new archive. The MCP server (deckcraft-cli mcp) has
been tested only for its handshake on AROS.
